metadata.title: Practice guideline recommendations summary: Disease-modifying therapies for adults with multiple sclerosis
top_takeaways: Disease-modifying therapy (DMT) decision-making in multiple sclerosis requires personalized, individualized strategies for starting, switching for breakthrough disease, or stopping treatment. Clinicians must actively engage patients regarding adherence, comorbidity risks, and specific progressive multifocal leukoencephalopathy risks associated with natalizumab, fingolimod, rituximab, ocrelizumab, and dimethyl fumarate.
